tooltip.text: Select this option to quickly change many Database Functions (Schema or DB Name) or Delete many at once.

config.script:
selected_function_id=self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0].function_id
	selected_function_name=self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0].function_name
	row_data=self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0]
	
	##check if function belongs to a function group
	params={"function_id":selected_function_id}
	check_function_call=system.db.execQuery("API/Equipment_Manager/Function_Group/Check_If_Function_Belongs_To_A_Function_Group", params)
	messageboxparams={"data":{"icon": "material/info",
			  "title": "",
			  "level": "warning",
			  "message": ""
			  }
			  }

	
	if len(check_function_call)>0:
		
		related_function_groups=""
		counter=1
		for group in check_function_call:
			related_function_groups+='{0}-{1}\n'.format(counter,group['function_group_name'])
			counter+=1

		messageboxparams['data']['message']="The selected function belongs to the following Function Group(s): {0} . You must remove the function from the group(s) before deleting it.".format(related_function_groups)
		messageboxparams['data']['title']="Unable to Delete"

					  
		system.perspective.openPopup("Validated", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Message_Box",messageboxparams, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)

	
	
	else:
		
		params={"function_id":selected_function_id,"function_name":selected_function_name,"data":row_data}
		system.perspective.openPopup("DelteFunction", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Delete_Function_Confirmation", params, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)

selected_rows=self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data
		
	messageboxparams={"data":{"icon": "material/info",
					  "title": "",
					  "level": "",
					  "message": ""}}

	
	#if username==None:
	#	username="User-Interface"
		
	### Check that all selected functions are database type
	
	all_database=True
	non_database_functions=[]
	for function in selected_rows:
		if function['sys_interface']!='Database':
			
			all_database=False
			non_database_functions.append(function['function_name'])
	
	
	if all_database==False:		
		messageboxparams['data']['message']="The multiselection mode only allows to edit functions of the Database Sys_Interface type. These functions must be deselected {0}".format(str(non_database_functions))
		messageboxparams['data']['title']="Only Database Type Edit Allowed"
		messageboxparams['data']["level"]= "warning"
							  
		system.perspective.openPopup("msg1", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Message_Box",messageboxparams, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)	
		
	
	elif all_database==True:
		
		params={"selected_rows":selected_rows}
		system.perspective.openPopup("EditDBFunction", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Edit_DB_Function_Multi", params, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
